summary: Ground-level fire lookout cabin at about 10,684 ft on the Wind River Indian Reservation, Fremont County, WY; listed as standing; no build or staffing history found.

access.note: On the Wind River Indian Reservation. No source describes public access or visiting rules; ask the tribes before going.

evidence.supports: listed under Bold Mountain (Meadow Creek) as a standing ground-type lookout

the reservation is shared by the Eastern Shoshone

corrections.why: The page gives the reservation as the location. It does not name a managing agency.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Read: the firelookout.com page, the FFLA Wyoming list and the Wikipedia article on the reservation. Two web searches found nothing on build date, design, staffing or fires. The access level 'permission' is carried over from the record; no source states a visiting rule. The record's 'tribal' ownership is not stated in any source read. Agency correction proposed.
